nodes.label: lakehouse_core.config
nodes.description: Loads and validates lakehouse.yaml; exposes LakehouseConfig Pydantic model and get_lakehouse_config()

nodes.label: lakehouse_core.catalogs
nodes.description: Builds and returns a PyIceberg catalog client from config; exposes get_iceberg_catalog()

nodes.label: lakehouse_core.paths
nodes.description: Helper functions for building GCS paths: zone_prefix(), table_prefix(), get_full_gcs_path()

nodes.label: lakehouse_core.tables
nodes.description: Table identifiers, contracts, and utilities: get_table_identifier(), get_table_contract()

nodes.label: configs/lakehouse.yaml
nodes.description: Central YAML config defining GCS bucket, prefix, zones (raw/bronze/silver/gold), catalog settings, and table contracts

nodes.label: LakehouseConfig
nodes.description: Pydantic BaseModel with fields: bucket (str), prefix (str), zones (dict), catalog (dict), tables (dict)

nodes.label: get_lakehouse_config()
nodes.description: Returns validated LakehouseConfig singleton loaded from configs/lakehouse.yaml

nodes.label: get_iceberg_catalog()
nodes.description: Builds and returns a PyIceberg catalog client using config from get_lakehouse_config()

nodes.label: get_table_identifier()
nodes.description: Splits dotted table name into (namespace, table_name) tuple for PyIceberg catalog operations

nodes.label: zone_prefix()
nodes.description: Returns GCS path prefix for a given zone name (e.g., 'bronze/')

nodes.label: table_prefix()
nodes.description: Returns GCS path prefix for a table including zone and domain (e.g., 'bronze/cenace/pend/')

nodes.label: Pure Library Boundary
nodes.description: Design principle: phoenix_lakehouse is strictly a library providing contracts and definitions; no ETL, no Prefect, no API calls, no data writing; all operational logic belongs in consuming repos
